verdict.rationale: Decagon documents scoped, short-lived JWT access for agent actions across customer systems and integrations 'with no custom code required,' plus explicit mention of agents adjusting 'refund logic,' supporting real action-taking with scoped auth. However there's no detailed documentation of per-action granularity (e.g., separate refund vs subscription-update scopes), no audit trail examples, and no independent/hands-on verification of actual API action execution — missing for 10: per-action scope definitions, action audit logging, and third-party verification of real transactional actions.
